items.description: Our signature loaf — crispy crust, open crumb, tangy flavor. Made with a 24-hour cold ferment.

items.description: Just like our Classic Plain Sourdough, but shaped ready for daily sandwiches.

items.name: Jalapeño Cheddar Sourdough
items.description: Jalapeño heat(not to spicy) and sharp cheddar folded into our classic dough. A fan favorite year-round!

items.name: Roasted Garlic, Olive & Rosemary Sourdough
items.description: Fragrant rosemary and fresh roasted garlic with kalamata olives folded into our classic dough.

items.name: Italian Parmesan Sourdough
items.description: Aromatic parmesan cheese folded into our classic sourdough dough.

items.name: Cinnamon Brown Sugar Sourdough
items.description: Swirled with Ceylon cinnamon and Brown Sugar. Amazing when toasted for breakfast, or as treats with butter or cream cheese.

items.name: Chocolate Chip Sourdough
items.description: Chocolate chips folded into our classic sourdough dough.

items.name: Orange Cranberry Walnut Sourdough
items.description: Tart dried cranberries and toasted walnuts in a lightly orange zest folded into our classic dough.. A winter favorite.

items.name: Lemon Blueberry Sourdough
items.description: Sweet spring flavors in every bite! Juicy blueberries and bright lemon zest folded into our classic dough.

items.name: Pumpkin Spice Sourdough
items.description: Warm fall flavors in every bite! Pumpkin puree and a blend of cozy spices folded into our classic dough.

items.name: Sourdough Focaccia (Half Sheet)
items.description: Crispy-bottomed, olive-oil-drenched focaccia topped with flaky salt and fresh herbs.

items.name: Sourdough Discard Crackers
items.description: Thin, crispy crackers made from sourdough discard. Perfect with cheese or hummus.

items.name: Sourdough English Mufics (Pack of 6)
items.description: These fly off our shelves fast! Soft, chewy, and perfect for breakfast sandwiches or simply toasted with butter.
